items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: Lee Polk came in the band... Lee Polk was on one side of me, Eddie was on the other side of me, and I'm in the middle between them two, and then there's two more saxophones -- we had five saxophones.

ctx.x: Now, I was saying that this showed a little example of Eddie. When I was talking about Lee Polk... Lee Polk had come in a little bit later, and Eddie and him became very good friends.
